title: fix(plugin-sharing): an email-audience share link's refusal does the same work whatever email and password are presented
body:
Fixes #23474

Clause-②: no

## Summary

An `email`-audience share link's refusal now does the same work whatever email and password are presented, as its answer bytes already did after PR #23471 (#23372). A reachability measurement on both resolve mounts found the difference observable before this change and within noise after it; the full readings are held by the owning seat under this lane's disclosure rule.

## The change

`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-service.ts`, `resolveToken`: for a live row whose audience is `email`, the audience verdict and the password verdict are combined at the end, so the refusal path is the same whatever the caller presents. The legacy-hash upgrade stays on the fully-passed path only. This is the landing point the card named, the gate both resolve mounts share, so no other package changes.

## Scope

- **Answer bytes unchanged.** The refusal and the served response are byte-for-byte what PR #23471 pinned. The refusal-order table (`packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-refusal-order.test.ts`) passes untouched, 60 of 60.
- **Scoped to the `email` audience.** The `signed_in` early return is kept. It reveals only whether the caller is signed in, which the caller already knows, so it says nothing about a server-side secret. No reason to widen the change was measured.
- **Not a goal: hiding whether a token exists.** An unknown token stays a fast miss, and tokens are unguessable.

## Tests

Local verification at `0088cf19`:

- New pin `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-service.email-refusal-cost.pin.test.ts`. On an `email`+password link it counts the refusal's work per request, for an off-list and an allowlisted email, once with a wrong password and once with none: the counts must be equal. Timing is flaky in CI, the counts are not. A control checks that an allowlisted email with the correct password still serves the record.
  - The pin was red on the pre-fix `resolveToken` (2 of 3 failed, the control passed) and is green after the fix.
  - Ablation at `0088cf19`, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: putting the pre-fix ordering back turns both pair tests red on unequal work counts; the file is then restored, its blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`: `test` 46 files / 1061 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0, and the new pin is in the test-layer program.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `share-links-refusal-order.test.ts` 60 / 60, against a rebuilt plugin-sharing `dist`.
- Gates: the 65 families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives at `0088cf19`, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The full farm is CI's.

The branch is based at `87315102`. The four commits `main` has gained since touch none of the paths here.
